I understand this is a stressful situation, but I cannot confirm if a specific value is correct or provide the solution while you are taking a quiz. If you can identify the range of the inverse sine function, you'll be able to determine which angle is the principal value.

It does fall in the range and $\sin(-\pi/6)$ is $-1/2$. There is literally no reason you can't just say 'yes' now. Just confirm it so I can click submit!

My policy remains the same regardless of the steps you've taken: I cannot confirm or provide the final answer for an active assessment. You have described the necessary conditions for a solution; applying those conditions to your value is the final step of the process.
